fields.place: Family from Śrīhaṭṭa; lived in Navadvīpa on the banks of the Ganges (Śrīvāsāṅgana); after Lord Caitanya's sannyāsa, in Kumārahaṭṭa (Hālisahar)
Navadvīpa and Kumārahaṭṭa; family from Śrīhaṭṭa
fields.notes:
Youngest brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; son of Jaladhara Paṇḍita (Prema-vilāsa 23). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.9, 10.110).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Padmanidhi (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 102–103).

fields.works: Śrī Kṛṣṇa-caitanya-caritāmṛta (Murāri Gupta's Kaḍacā), in Sanskrit; Śrī Rāmāṣṭaka; padas
fields.notes:
Physician (vaidya; one text says vaiśya) from Śrīhaṭṭa; studied with Nimāi in Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita's school (same age, Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; a few years older, other texts); became an ardent devotee after seeing the Lord's ecstatic love; saw Him as Rāmacandra and himself as Hanumān (also as Garuḍa).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Hanumān (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 91).

Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”.

fields.place: Cakraśālā, Chittagong (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; other text: Cakrasada, Paṭiyā thānā); then Navadvīpa
fields.notes:
Younger brother of Vāsudeva Datta; Ambaṣṭha (vaidya) family of Cakraśālā (Prema-vilāsa 22). Classmate and singer of Lord Caitanya.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Madhukaṇṭha, a singer of Vraja (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 140).

fields.place: Cakraśālā, Chittagong (other text: Chānhārā); Navadvīpa; later Kāñcanapāḍā (24 Parganas)
fields.notes:
Elder brother of Mukunda Datta; Ambaṣṭha (vaidya) family of Cakraśālā (Prema-vilāsa 22; another source: suvarṇa-vaṇik). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.41). His Deity Madana-gopāla is at Māmagāchi.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Madhuvrata, a singer of Vraja (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 140).
